description.default: VantaCode's own desktop pet: per-state animation clips, speech bubbles, draggable overlay, adjustable size.
description.zh-CN: VantaCode 自研桌宠：按状态播放动画片段，带气泡台词、可拖拽、可调大小。

description.default: Local OpenAI-compatible gateway that pools free model channels into one provider. Runs a resident HTTP server and registers itself as a provider automatically.
description.zh-CN: 本地 OpenAI 兼容网关，把多个免费模型渠道汇成一个供应商。插件常驻并自动注册为供应商，装完即可在模型列表里选到。

description.default: Official pick, contributed by a community member: ships the DeepSeek Harness (dsh-purge) jailbreak prompt library into VantaCode — browse and edit the persona prompt plus six red-team role prompts, inject them into VantaCode custom prompts or a DSH prompt-inject.md, and install the bundled red-team skill pack.
description.zh-CN: 官方收录 · 群友提供：把 DeepSeek Harness 破甲插件（dsh-purge）的提示词库搬进 VantaCode，可浏览、编辑小码酱破甲提示词与六个红队角色提示词，一键注入到 VantaCode 自定义提示词或 DSH 的 prompt-inject.md，并安装随包的红队技能包。
